cells.reason: Annex I point 3.6.8.1 reads 'Seaweed except wakame' at 30 mg/kg on the product as placed on the market, applying from 2025-07-01, so it covers the nori, kombu, kelp and dulse members of this row on the as-sold basis; but the row expressly names wakame, which the anchor's own scope excludes and which the same instrument governs separately at point 3.6.8.2 (eu2024_ni_wakame_40000, 40 mg/kg; Switzerland VHK mirrors the split, ch_vhk_2026_ni_seetang_30000 'ausgenommen Wakame' and ch_vhk_2026_ni_wakame-undaria-pinnatifida_40000). The 30000 value is at least as protective as the law for every member, so the number stands, but a 'gov / firm' cell cannot cite a scope that excludes a named member of its product: the law splits seaweed from wakame and the row should adopt that split or disclose the wakame tightening as precautionary. No non-gated same-basis nickel row stricter than 30000 covers seaweed (CH VHK Seetang is equal at 30000).
